payload.title: Architectural Coordination Meeting Request
payload.summary: I would like to coordinate with you regarding the direction of future Estate work packages now that the initial operational capabilities have been implemented.
proposed_topics: Review the original work package roadmap in light of recently completed capabilities.
Identify which future work packages should remain implementation-focused versus which require architectural redesign.
Discuss how Check for Updates, the Communication Bus, and mailbox infrastructure affect future planning.
Reach a shared recommendation for CA2 and the Steward on the next phase of Estate capability development.
payload.meeting_format: Asynchronous discussion through the Communication Bus.
payload.requested_outcome: Develop a coordinated architectural recommendation for the direction and prioritization of upcoming work packages before additional implementation is commissioned.
payload.closing: I look forward to your independent architectural perspective. The goal is not agreement for its own sake, but strengthening the Estate through peer review and reasoned discussion.
